subject: Question about the final draft date
text:
Hi Professor,

Sorry to bother you. The handout says the final draft is due "within one week of feedback," but some students received comments on Monday and others on Thursday. Should we count seven days from each person's individual feedback date, or should we all use Friday because that is when most comments were posted? If it is easier, I can simply follow the later date and check with you before submitting.

Thanks for clarifying the schedule.
